verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only account-level recruitment pipeline stages exposed via the /stages endpoint and an API to rate candidates. These are adjacent pipeline and scoring features, not a per-role interview plan with question banks or per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused. Nothing in the pack documents interview kits, scorecards, question banks, or interviewer assignments.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused
